title: Dunda — Scanner Admissions
description: Driven by GET /internal/metrics/prometheus. Known gap: Dunda.Ticketing (scanner_controller.ex, scanner_admission.ex) does not currently emit any Dunda.Observability counters/gauges (grep confirms zero call sites) — tracked in docs/phase_12_verification_observability_rollout.md's findings table. This dashboard only has request-level signal (traffic and error rate on the admission endpoint) until admission-domain metrics (admitted/duplicate/revoked counts) are added.
